paper_title: The Ithildin library for efficient numerical solution of anisotropic reaction-diffusion problems in excitable media
evidence_summary: Atlas paper 836 lists simcardems among established finite-element simulation software and its cited reference 65 explicitly names simcardems as a FEniCS-based cardiac electro-mechanics solver. The current FEniCS Project site independently identifies FEniCS as an open-source finite-element PDE-solving platform. This verifies a paper-software mention, not official paper code. Stage 1 also lists Atlas ID 752 on CR000210, but no Stage-1 PRL exists for 752 and none is invented here.
evidence_location: paper discussion of established FEM software and reference 65; FEniCS Project home/download/documentation pages
